is_anopheles.evidence: The review mentions Anopheles gambiae (e.g. Abstract p. 1, p. 8, and p. 9) alongside Aedes species.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The article is a review focusing on inward rectifier potassium (Kir) channels and Malpighian tubule physiology; it does not genotype any of the target insecticide resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies for target markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquito populations from Africa were collected or genotyped.

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is an explicit review article ('Review', p. 1) summarizing previous physiological, biochemical, and pharmacological work.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field mosquito collection locations are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field mosquito collection dates are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable as this is a review article without primary field genotype data.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; paper is fundamentally ineligible.

assessment.summary: This is a review article summarizing research on mosquito Malpighian tubules as physiological targets for mosquito control via inhibition of inward-rectifier potassium (Kir) channels and related pathways. It contains no primary field data or genotyping of target insecticide resistance markers.
